claude_proposed_widenings.name: bond_objects
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: Sovereign Glue's core deterministic mechanic is creating a permanent adhesive bond between two objects. No existing effect atom models persistent object-to-object adhesion or a bond that can later be broken only by named counters.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: "This viscous, milky-white substance can form a permanent adhesive bond between any two objects."

claude_proposed_widenings.name: Attachment.object_or_item_pair
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The existing attachment grammar only targets self, creatures, areas, companions, or marks. This item targets two objects rather than a creature or area.

claude_proposed_widenings.name: delayed_set_then_persist
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The glue does not bond immediately on activation; it is applied first, then sets after 1 minute, and only then becomes permanent. The current activation/passive shapes do not express a delayed effect that matures into a persistent bond.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: "Applying an ounce of Sovereign Glue takes a Utilize action, and the applied glue takes 1 minute to set. Once it has done so, the bond it creates..."

claude_proposed_widenings.name: UseCountCap.found_quantity_roll
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The consumable stock is not a fixed charge pool or rest-reset resource; each found container starts with a rolled quantity in ounces.
